clips.title: The story
paras: The Deeprun Tram carries travelers beneath the earth between Ironforge and Stormwind City. King Magni Bronzebeard commissioned it after the Second War, and its twin tracks now carry citizens, soldiers, and goods between the Alliance capitals.

King Magni Bronzebeard wanted dwarven aid and supplies to reach Stormwind faster after the Second War. Mountain passes slowed the journey, so he asked High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque to design an underground railway. Gnomish engineers cut the route beneath a mountain and through a vast subterranean lake. Rats plagued the excavation, but the tram was completed. It carries thousands of travelers between Ironforge and Stormwind without charge.
